reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(signup_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT signup_date, signups,
  LAG(signups) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date) AS prev_signups
FROM daily

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(signup_ts AS DATE)
), paired AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT d.signup_date, d.signups, (SELECT MAX(d2.signup_date) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.signup_date < d.signup_date) AS prev_date
  FROM daily d
)
SELECT p.signup_date, p.signups, b.signups AS prev_signups
FROM paired p
LEFT JOIN daily b ON b.signup_date = p.prev_date
